authored_root_metadata.authority: Founder-approved complete prescription content; exact canonical definitions/versions/events and physical publication remain pending.

policies.approved_variants: Exercise variant content is approved 2026-10-25: main front-rack reverse lunge uses a BARBELL front rack; cable Pallof press uses SPLIT STANCE. Preparation ramps remain separate from working sets. No RDL/lunge load derives from a squat benchmark.
policies.audience: Developing or advanced athletes able to run continuously for 45 minutes.
policies.benchmarks: 10 km run time, 2 km row time, back squat 5RM total external load, strict OHP 5RM total external load, maximum strict pull-ups (zero valid). Own test date and source/type required; no freshness cutoff or automatic latest/best selection.
policies.capture: Prescribed targets, advisory guidance and actual performance are separate. Athletes may record actual load in existing supported actual-load fields or optional notes; no new mandatory result, race attestation or division lookup follows from advisory text.
policies.core_progression: Optional W5 carry load, longer plank lever or Pallof resistance only with position maintained and athlete choice. No compulsory increase. W4 carry and Pallof lighter.
policies.core_rest: 45–60 seconds as needed; no compulsory recovery at each side change is prescribed.
policies.duration: Generally 60–90 minutes; do not add filler. Preparation and cooldown are additional to main running.
policies.equipment: Approved variants use barbell/rack (including front-rack reverse lunge), dumbbells/incline bench, pull-up bar, cable station (including split-stance Pallof), carry space, rower, fan bike, SkiErg, wall ball/target, kettlebell and preparation bands. Canonical identity/version authority and marketing/prerequisite copy are separate.
policies.finisher_load: Effort/technique selected, no fixed kilograms. Rep work leaves recovery inside the minute; record athlete scaling using existing supported logging. “Use your race weight” in these circuits is advisory only: no exact load, target height, verified race standard or division lookup is prescribed. Explicit prescriptions and formal assessments retain their own requirements.
policies.history: Explicit benchmark replacement acceptance affects future unstarted sessions only; started/completed prescriptions immutable. Actuals separate. No inferred loads for RDL/lunge/other press/pull-ups.
policies.periodisation: W1–3 build; W4 reduces gym/finisher demand with modest running reduction; W5–7 build; W8 consolidates.
policies.personalisation: Only quality running, dedicated rowing and back squat have approved numeric derivation. Pace=10 km seconds/10; 4–5 min x1.00–1.05, 6–7 min x1.02–1.07, 10 min x1.03–1.08. Row split=2 km seconds/4, +10–15 seconds for 2-min reps, +12–18 for 3-min reps; W4 +18–23, W8 +15–20. Squat=5RM x authored basis points/10000, nearest configured total barbell increment, ties down. No guessed increment. Missing means unavailable, plus authored effort only; no invented row fallback.
policies.post_base: No compulsory post-Base assessment; representative benchmarks needed before next plan. Test Week is a separate unauthored programme, never inserted here.
policies.purpose: Build aerobic capacity, compound strength, shoulders/pulling, grip and bracing before specific HYROX preparation. Base is purpose, not beginner status.
policies.running_effort: Easy/long conversational, RPE about 3–4. Quality RPE about 7, repeatable. Choose within duration windows by feel/recovery; no level bands or invented HR zones.
policies.schedule: Eight weeks; Mon Gym A, Tue easy run, Wed Gym B, Thu quality run, Fri Gym C, Sat long run, Sun rest. One session/day; six/week.
policies.strength_rest: Back squat working sets: 150–180 seconds throughout; warm-up sets separate. RDL/reverse lunge: 120–180 seconds. Upper pair A: 90–120 seconds after pair; B/C: 90 seconds.
policies.substitution: Running intended for all three aerobic sessions. Bike substitution only under verified existing rules plus athlete acceptance, preserving duration/effort, never running pace. Approved variant content does not grant new substitution or canonical mapping authority.
policies.upper_progression: Build repetitions within ranges before suggesting load increases; athlete accepts. No OHP load inference from its benchmark. No automatic progression on completion.

preparation.execution_note: Set up the next station during recovery. Budget includes ramps and light pair rehearsal; if not ready, extend preparation and record that fact rather than rush or cut approved working sets. Full-session timing is an estimate, not a fixed sum or a new tempo.
preparation.ramp_up: After the circuit, perform 2–3 short squat ramp sets: empty bar or very light × 8; add load × 5; if useful, a final heavier × 2–3. Work towards, never above, the planned first working load; each ramp feels comfortable with several reps spare. Use about 30–60 s to change load/recover, then 60–90 s before the first working set. If the working load is light, omit the unnecessary heavier ramp. Working sets still rest 150–180 s.

shared_policies.duration: Generally 60–90 minutes; do not add filler. Preparation and cooldown are additional to main running.

shared_policies.finisher_load: Effort/technique selected, no fixed kilograms. shared_policies.history: Explicit benchmark replacement acceptance affects future unstarted sessions only; started/completed prescriptions immutable. Actuals separate. No inferred loads for RDL/lunge/other press/pull-ups.
shared_policies.periodisation: W1–3 build; W4 reduces gym/finisher demand with modest running reduction; W5–7 build; W8 consolidates.
shared_policies.personalisation: Only quality running, dedicated rowing and back squat have approved numeric derivation. Pace=10 km seconds/10; 4–5 min x1.00–1.05, 6–7 min x1.02–1.07, 10 min x1.03–1.08. Row split=2 km seconds/4, +10–15 seconds for 2-min reps, +12–18 for 3-min reps; W4 +18–23, W8 +15–20. Squat=5RM x authored basis points/10000, nearest configured total barbell increment, ties down. No guessed increment. Missing means unavailable, plus authored effort only; no invented row fallback.
shared_policies.post_base: No compulsory post-Base assessment; representative benchmarks needed before next plan. Test Week is a separate unauthored programme, never inserted here.
shared_policies.purpose: Build aerobic capacity, compound strength, shoulders/pulling, grip and bracing before specific HYROX preparation. Base is purpose, not beginner status.
shared_policies.running_effort: Easy/long conversational, RPE about 3–4. Quality RPE about 7, repeatable. Choose within duration windows by feel/recovery; no level bands or invented HR zones.
shared_policies.schedule: Eight weeks; Mon Gym A, Tue easy run, Wed Gym B, Thu quality run, Fri Gym C, Sat long run, Sun rest. One session/day; six/week.
shared_policies.strength_rest: Back squat working sets: 150–180 seconds throughout; warm-up sets separate. RDL/reverse lunge: 120–180 seconds. Upper pair A: 90–120 seconds after pair; B/C: 90 seconds.
shared_policies.substitution: Running intended for all three aerobic sessions. Bike substitution only under verified existing rules plus athlete acceptance, preserving duration/effort, never running pace. Approved variant content does not grant new substitution or canonical mapping authority.
shared_policies.upper_progression: Build repetitions within ranges before suggesting load increases; athlete accepts. No OHP load inference from its benchmark. No automatic progression on completion.

blocks.content:
12–15 min total preparation, including the easy warm-up above; 2 rounds: 8 bodyweight squat, 8 glute bridge, 6 dead bug per side, 10 light band pull apart. After the circuit, perform 2–3 short squat ramp sets: empty bar or very light × 8; add load × 5; if useful, a final heavier × 2–3. Work towards, never above, the planned first working load; each ramp feels comfortable with several reps spare. Use about 30–60 s to change load/recover, then 60–90 s before the first working set. If the working load is light, omit the unnecessary heavier ramp. Working sets still rest 150–180 s.
Bodyweight squat: bodyweight. Standing, feet about shoulder-width, hands in front for balance. No implement. Sit down between the hips with heels supported. Stand upright under control.
Bodyweight floor glute bridge: bodyweight. Supine on floor, knees bent, feet flat about hip-width. No implement; arms rest beside the body. Raise the hips until trunk and thighs align without excessive back arch. Lower under control.
Alternating dead bug: bodyweight. Supine; hips and knees bent about 90 degrees, arms pointing upwards. No implement. Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping trunk position controlled. Return and alternate sides.
Light band pull-apart: resistance band. Standing with arms reaching forwards at about chest height. Overhand grip on a light band, hands about shoulder-width apart. Pull the band apart with soft elbows until arms open to the sides. Return slowly without leaning back.

blocks.content:
easy bike
Easy fan-bike preparation: air bike. Same seated fan-bike setup as the main fan-bike movement. Closed neutral grip on moving handles. Pedal and use both handles gently; easy effort is a session instruction, not a new identity.
blocks.title: Easy preparation

blocks.content:
12–15 min total preparation, including the easy warm-up above; 2 rounds: 8 unloaded hip hinge, 6 reverse lunge per side, 10 light row. Perform two RDL ramp sets: very light × 8, then a moderate load × 5, both comfortably short of fatigue; rest about 30–60 s while changing load. Choose by feel and hinge control, not a squat benchmark. Before the first press/row pair, take one brief easy rehearsal of each if needed; this is preparation, not another working pair.
Unloaded standing hip hinge: bodyweight. Standing about hip-width, knees softly bent. Hands rest across the chest or on hips; no load. Move hips backwards while the torso tips forwards. Stand by extending the hips without leaning back.
Bodyweight reverse lunge: bodyweight. Standing upright with space to step backwards. No implement; hands free for balance. Step one foot backwards and lower under control. Return to the original standing position before the next rep.
Light chest-supported dumbbell row: dumbbell, adjustable bench. Same supported 30-degree bench position as the working chest-supported row. Neutral grip. Row light dumbbells towards the lower ribs and lower under control.

12–15 min total preparation, including the easy warm-up above; 2 rounds: 6 reverse lunge per side, 8 light scapular row, 8 wall slide. Light bilateral cable row with scapular control: cable machine, neutral row handle. Standing facing a chest-height cable; stable parallel stance, torso upright. Two-handed neutral grip on a short row handle. Draw shoulder blades back as elbows bend and handle approaches the lower chest. Reach forwards under control.
Standing forearm wall slide: wall. Standing facing a wall, forearms supported vertically against it, elbows bent. No implement. Slide both forearms upwards while keeping the trunk controlled. Slide back down within the available controlled range.

ski erg
Standing double-pole SkiErg: ski erg. Standing facing a two-handle SkiErg with arms raised under control. One handle in each hand, closed grip. Drive both handles down with coordinated arms/trunk and knee flexion. Recover upwards under control.
blocks.title: Easy preparation

12–15 min total preparation, including the easy warm-up above; 2 rounds: 6 reverse lunge per side, 8 light scapular row, 8 wall slide. Perform two front-rack reverse-lunge ramp sets: a light barbell front rack × 4 per leg, then a moderate barbell front rack × 2 per leg, with about 30–60 s to recover/change load. Keep balance and the front rack comfortable. Choose loads by feel, never a squat benchmark. Before the first press/row pair, take one brief easy rehearsal if needed.
Bodyweight reverse lunge: bodyweight. Standing upright with space to step backwards. No implement; hands free for balance. Step one foot backwards and lower under control. Return to the original standing position before the next rep.
Light bilateral cable row with scapular control: cable machine, neutral row handle. Standing facing a chest-height cable; stable parallel stance, torso upright. Two-handed neutral grip on a short row handle. Draw shoulder blades back as elbows bend and handle approaches the lower chest. Reach forwards under control.
Standing forearm wall slide: wall. Standing facing a wall, forearms supported vertically against it, elbows bent. No implement. Slide both forearms upwards while keeping the trunk controlled. Slide back down within the available controlled range.

preparation.execution_note: Set up the next station during recovery. Budget includes ramps and light pair rehearsal; if not ready, extend preparation and record that fact rather than rush or cut approved working sets. Full-session timing is an estimate, not a fixed sum or a new tempo.
preparation.ramp_up: Perform two front-rack reverse-lunge ramp sets: a light barbell front rack × 4 per leg, then a moderate barbell front rack × 2 per leg, with about 30–60 s to recover/change load. Keep balance and the front rack comfortable. Choose loads by feel, never a squat benchmark. Before the first press/row pair, take one brief easy rehearsal if needed.

shared_policies.approved_variants: Exercise variant content is approved 2026-10-25: main front-rack reverse lunge uses a BARBELL front rack; cable Pallof press uses SPLIT STANCE. Preparation ramps remain separate from working sets. No RDL/lunge load derives from a squat benchmark.
shared_policies.audience: Developing or advanced athletes able to run continuously for 45 minutes.
shared_policies.benchmarks: 10 km run time, 2 km row time, back squat 5RM total external load, strict OHP 5RM total external load, maximum strict pull-ups (zero valid). Own test date and source/type required; no freshness cutoff or automatic latest/best selection.
shared_policies.capture: Prescribed targets, advisory guidance and actual performance are separate. Athletes may record actual load in existing supported actual-load fields or optional notes; no new mandatory result, race attestation or division lookup follows from advisory text.
shared_policies.core_progression: Optional W5 carry load, longer plank lever or Pallof resistance only with position maintained and athlete choice. No compulsory increase. W4 carry and Pallof lighter.
shared_policies.core_rest: 45–60 seconds as needed; no compulsory recovery at each side change is prescribed.
shared_policies.duration: Generally 60–90 minutes; do not add filler. Preparation and cooldown are additional to main running.
shared_policies.equipment: Approved variants use barbell/rack (including front-rack reverse lunge), dumbbells/incline bench, pull-up bar, cable station (including split-stance Pallof), carry space, rower, fan bike, SkiErg, wall ball/target, kettlebell and preparation bands. Canonical identity/version authority and marketing/prerequisite copy are separate.
shared_policies.finisher_load: Effort/technique selected, no fixed kilograms. Rep work leaves recovery inside the minute; record athlete scaling using existing supported logging. “Use your race weight” in these circuits is advisory only: no exact load, target height, verified race standard or division lookup is prescribed. Explicit prescriptions and formal assessments retain their own requirements.
shared_policies.history: Explicit benchmark replacement acceptance affects future unstarted sessions only; started/completed prescriptions immutable. Actuals separate. No inferred loads for RDL/lunge/other press/pull-ups.
shared_policies.periodisation: W1–3 build; W4 reduces gym/finisher demand with modest running reduction; W5–7 build; W8 consolidates.
shared_policies.personalisation: Only quality running, dedicated rowing and back squat have approved numeric derivation. Pace=10 km seconds/10; 4–5 min x1.00–1.05, 6–7 min x1.02–1.07, 10 min x1.03–1.08. Row split=2 km seconds/4, +10–15 seconds for 2-min reps, +12–18 for 3-min reps; W4 +18–23, W8 +15–20. Squat=5RM x authored basis points/10000, nearest configured total barbell increment, ties down. No guessed increment. Missing means unavailable, plus authored effort only; no invented row fallback.
shared_policies.post_base: No compulsory post-Base assessment; representative benchmarks needed before next plan. Test Week is a separate unauthored programme, never inserted here.
shared_policies.purpose: Build aerobic capacity, compound strength, shoulders/pulling, grip and bracing before specific HYROX preparation. Base is purpose, not beginner status.
shared_policies.running_effort: Easy/long conversational, RPE about 3–4. Quality RPE about 7, repeatable. Choose within duration windows by feel/recovery; no level bands or invented HR zones.
shared_policies.schedule: Eight weeks; Mon Gym A, Tue easy run, Wed Gym B, Thu quality run, Fri Gym C, Sat long run, Sun rest. One session/day; six/week.
shared_policies.strength_rest: Back squat working sets: 150–180 seconds throughout; warm-up sets separate. RDL/reverse lunge: 120–180 seconds. Upper pair A: 90–120 seconds after pair; B/C: 90 seconds.
shared_policies.substitution: Running intended for all three aerobic sessions. Bike substitution only under verified existing rules plus athlete acceptance, preserving duration/effort, never running pace. Approved variant content does not grant new substitution or canonical mapping authority.
shared_policies.upper_progression: Build repetitions within ranges before suggesting load increases; athlete accepts. No OHP load inference from its benchmark. No automatic progression on completion.

blocks.content:
ski erg
Standing double-pole SkiErg: ski erg. Standing facing a two-handle SkiErg with arms raised under control. One handle in each hand, closed grip. Drive both handles down with coordinated arms/trunk and knee flexion. Recover upwards under control.
blocks.title: Easy preparation

blocks.content:
12–15 min total preparation, including the easy warm-up above; 2 rounds: 6 reverse lunge per side, 8 light scapular row, 8 wall slide. Perform two front-rack reverse-lunge ramp sets: a light barbell front rack × 4 per leg, then a moderate barbell front rack × 2 per leg, with about 30–60 s to recover/change load. Keep balance and the front rack comfortable. Choose loads by feel, never a squat benchmark. Before the first press/row pair, take one brief easy rehearsal if needed.
Bodyweight reverse lunge: bodyweight. Standing upright with space to step backwards. No implement; hands free for balance. Step one foot backwards and lower under control. Return to the original standing position before the next rep.
Light bilateral cable row with scapular control: cable machine, neutral row handle. Standing facing a chest-height cable; stable parallel stance, torso upright. Two-handed neutral grip on a short row handle. Draw shoulder blades back as elbows bend and handle approaches the lower chest. Reach forwards under control.
Standing forearm wall slide: wall. Standing facing a wall, forearms supported vertically against it, elbows bent. No implement. Slide both forearms upwards while keeping the trunk controlled. Slide back down within the available controlled range.
blocks.title: Preparation circuit and ramps

blocks.content:
front rack reverse lunge
Barbell front-rack reverse lunge: barbell, rack. Standing with the barbell supported across the front of the shoulders in a front rack. Front-rack grip with fingers under the bar and elbows forwards to support the rack. Step one leg backwards and lower into a lunge while retaining the barbell front rack. Drive through the front foot to return; complete the prescribed reps per leg.

execution_sequence: Step one leg backwards and lower into a lunge while retaining the barbell front rack.
Drive through the front foot to return; complete the prescribed reps per leg.
variant.grip: Front-rack grip with fingers under the bar and elbows forwards to support the rack.
variant.name: Barbell front-rack reverse lunge
variant.position: Standing with the barbell supported across the front of the shoulders in a front rack.

blocks.title: front_rack_reverse_lunge

blocks.coach_notes: Complete the pair, then take the authored rest.
blocks.content:
Alternate the two prescribed exercises. Rest 90–90 s after the pair.
Seated dumbbell shoulder press: dumbbell, adjustable bench. Seated against a near-upright backrest; feet supported, dumbbells at shoulder level. Neutral grip, palms facing inward. Press both dumbbells overhead without leg drive. Lower to shoulder level under control.
Split-stance single-arm cable row: cable machine, single cable handle. Standing facing a cable at lower-chest height, one foot forward, torso square. One hand on a D-handle with a neutral grip. Row towards the same-side lower ribs without rotating the torso. Reach forwards under control; complete the prescribed side.

execution_sequence: Press both dumbbells overhead without leg drive.
Lower to shoulder level under control.
variant.grip: Neutral grip, palms facing inward.
variant.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
variant.position: Seated against a near-upright backrest; feet supported, dumbbells at shoulder level.

execution_sequence: Row towards the same-side lower ribs without rotating the torso.
Reach forwards under control; complete the prescribed side.
variant.grip: One hand on a D-handle with a neutral grip.
variant.name: Split-stance single-arm cable row
variant.position: Standing facing a cable at lower-chest height, one foot forward, torso square.

blocks.title: Upper-body pair

blocks.content:
pallof press
Split-stance cable Pallof press: cable machine, single cable handle. Standing side-on to a chest-height cable in a stable split stance, one foot forwards and one back; handle at sternum. Both hands clasp the single cable handle. Press hands straight forwards without rotating the torso. Retain the authored extended hold, then return to the sternum.

execution_sequence: Press hands straight forwards without rotating the torso.
Retain the authored extended hold, then return to the sternum.
variant.grip: Both hands clasp the single cable handle.
variant.name: Split-stance cable Pallof press
variant.position: Standing side-on to a chest-height cable in a stable split stance, one foot forwards and one back; handle at sternum.
